title: Hushed Face Emoji 😯 Meaning: Quiet Surprise or “Oh”
description: The hushed face emoji 😯 raises its eyebrows over a small open mouth: quiet surprise, a soft oh, or being stunned into silence. See how it compares with 😮 and 😲.
summary: The 😯 hushed face means subdued surprise. With raised eyebrows and a small open mouth, it shows someone who has gone quiet at what they just learned: mildly shocked, impressed or humbled. It often accompanies oh or I see and is the least dramatic of the surprised faces.
meaning: Hushed means made silent, and the name fits. 😯 looks like a person who was about to speak and stopped. The eyebrows lift, the mouth forms a small o, and no sound comes out. People use it for news that gives them pause, such as a quiet revelation in conversation, a correction they did not expect or a detail that changes the picture.

Its typical caption is oh. Not the loud oh of amazement but the lower one of realization: oh, that is what you meant; oh, I did not know she was sick; oh, so it was you. The emoji signals that the information has landed and the sender is absorbing it. It can carry a trace of embarrassment at having been wrong.

Some read it as awe. Faced with a beautiful view, an impressive piece of work or a generous gesture, 😯 expresses being struck silent in a good way. Others use it for mild scandal, the wide-eyed look when gossip turns out to be juicier than expected, though the open-mouth and astonished faces are more common choices there.

It is among the less used faces, largely because it sits so close to 😮 and many people cannot tell them apart on a small screen. Those who choose it deliberately tend to want its softer quality: surprise without noise, and attention without judgment. It suits replies where a louder gasp would seem to make the moment about the person reacting.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: It follows an explanation that changes your understanding. A friend tells you why they missed your party and 😯 says I had no idea, I am sorry I assumed. It also works as a restrained reaction to gossip when you want to seem interested but not gleeful.

contexts.label: In sensitive conversations
contexts.body: Because it is quiet, it suits moments when someone shares something surprising and personal. It shows you are taken aback and listening. Follow it with words, though. Left alone, any surprised face can leave the other person wondering what you think of them.

contexts.label: On social media
contexts.body: It turns up under before-and-after photos, plot reveals and unexpected announcements, usually from commenters who are impressed more than shocked. It reads as thoughtful. In threads full of crying-laughing and skull emojis, its calm stands out as a more measured response.

contexts.label: At work
contexts.body: It is a mild, acceptable way to acknowledge surprising information, such as a sudden change of plan, without sounding alarmed or critical. It pairs well with oh, understood. For anything involving a person's performance or private circumstances, respond in full sentences instead.

examples.text: Oh 😯 I didn't realize you two had broken up
examples.meaning: Quiet surprise with a hint of awkwardness.

examples.text: 😯 so that's why he left early
You've been doing this for ten years? 😯
examples.meaning: Impressed by something they had not known.
A startled realization about a mistake.
Mildly scandalized by a piece of gossip.

combos.meaning: Oh, now I get it; a sudden realization.
Surprised and paying close attention to what comes next.
Shocked into silence, or promising not to repeat what was heard.

confusedWith.difference: 😮 has no eyebrows and a rounder mouth, and reads as a general, slightly louder wow. 😯 has raised brows and a smaller mouth, suggesting someone who has gone quiet. In practice many people use them interchangeably.
😲 shows full astonishment, with a wide gasp. 😯 is several notches lower. Winning a prize is 😲; learning your coworker used to live on your street is 😯.
🤫 holds a finger to its lips and tells others to be quiet or keep a secret. 😯 is not asking for silence; it has fallen silent itself out of surprise. The word hushed causes the mix-up.

avoid: Do not use it to tell someone to be quiet; that is the shushing face.
Avoid leaving it as your only reply to a personal disclosure.
Skip it when you need to show strong shock, since many readers will see only mild interest.
design: A yellow face with open eyes, raised eyebrows and a small, round open mouth. The eyebrows are what set it apart from the plain open-mouth face. Vendors render it similarly, with minor differences in mouth size and brow height that make it look anywhere from gently surprised to slightly worried.

faqs.a: It means the sender is quietly surprised, usually by learning something they did not know. Think of a soft oh. It is not strong shock and not negative by itself; it shows the news made them stop for a moment.

The hushed face has eyebrows and a smaller mouth, giving a quieter, more stunned feel. The open-mouth face has no eyebrows and a simple round mouth. The meanings overlap heavily, and most people will understand either as surprise.
No. Despite the name, it does not hush anyone. It depicts a person who has become quiet from surprise. To ask for silence or secrecy, people use 🤫, and to promise it they use 🤐.

faqs.q: What does 😯 mean from a guy or girl?
faqs.a: They were surprised by what you said, often in a thoughtful way. It could mean they are impressed or that they realize they misjudged something. It has no romantic meaning. Their next message normally makes the feeling clear.
